value.rationale: The sequence \(a_r(n)\) is not an arbitrary slice: it is the canonical sequence of local cell minima on which the source's sharp negative-binomial mean-tail theorem rests. Strict concavity adds a structural diminishing-returns law for every positive shape parameter and explains the source monotonicity through an exact product of two decreasing positive mechanisms. This is a natural strengthening of the central sequence rather than a routine numerical refinement.
